mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in tightening periods compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment decline.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of rising unemployment compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth for two consecutive quarters signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations adjust downward.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of declining GDP growth compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as increased production capacity supports economic growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of increasing industrial production compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales signals a strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending rise.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of increasing housing starts and retail sales compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 2% and CPI inflation exceeds 3% year-over-year, the combination signals a high inflation environment with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real returns are eroded.
regime_hint: high inflation with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of high inflation and tight monetary policy compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as immediate concerns about economic health arise.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower in periods of decreasing nonfarm payrolls compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales for two consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and spending rise.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of increasing retail sales compared to baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
